p8_b4.ocr: Pfannschmidt et al. 1994 recorded a total of 58 patients with DR, with 22 combined cases of head injury, leading to a co- existence percentage of 37.9%. Balci et al. 2004 had 137 total patients with DR, 33 of whom also had a head injury, resulting in a 24.0% co-existence rate. Lastly, Ilgenfritz et al. 1992 documented 52 patients with DR, with 21 combined patients, producing a co-existence percentage of 40.3%.
